title: RQ-D64-Balanced: unequal blocks and near-one-third online constant

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE RQ-D64-Balanced algorithm and exact all-n parameter rule in the joint evidence recover full s under ModelM, including clean input and every admissible online unflagged replacement strategy with at most floor(3333*Q/(10000*n^(64))) replacements among ACTUAL Q acquired originals, with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY branch including all retries, rejects, discards, failures, wrong numerical labels, partial inputs and cutoffs, its total charged sequential work T is O(2^(n/130)*n^(2243/65)*(log2 n)^2). This is its full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2, with explicit finite costs at n=1 absorbed by absolute constants. Its exact envelope growth index is 1. All constants are independent of N,s and outcomes. This holds jointly with the other three resources and the same 3333/(10000*n^(64)) fractional-tolerance declaration for this algorithm/configuration.

For the SAME RQ-D64-Balanced algorithm/configuration as all four resource claims, the guaranteed fraction is epsilon(n)=3333/(10000*n^(64)) under exact online unflagged replacement ModelM in the joint evidence and the identical error_model text below. For every N>=2,s and admissible strategy with at most floor(3333*Q/(10000*n^(64))) replacements among ACTUAL Q acquired originals including rejects and discards, unconditional full-secret success is at least 1-2^-8>2/3 jointly with all four every-branch bounds. Honest copies are fresh rho_s tensor-independent of all prior systems, each replacement decision precedes the current honest draw, and bad copies may be arbitrarily correlated through private workspace. No flags are supplied. Clean input is included.

structured.error_model: Online unflagged replacement model. Before each acquired copy, an adversary chooses a classical replacement bit using N, s, the past classical transcript and private quantum workspace, without access to the current fresh honest draw or future protocol coins. A non-replaced copy is a fresh rho_s tensor-independent of all prior systems; a replaced copy is any state on the same n+1 input qubits and may be entangled with private workspace and other replacements. No replacement flag is supplied. At termination Q is the actual count of all acquired copies, including rejects and discards, and at most floor(epsilon(n)*Q) were replaced almost surely for every admissible strategy; this is a promise, not postselection on budget fulfillment. Current honest labels cannot be inspected before deciding that call's type. All other gates and measurements are ideal. The probability is uniform over N,s and all such online strategies.
